common: &common
  type: trojan
  port: 443
  password: password
  sni: anchor.example

proxies:
  - name: "Anchor One"
    <<: *common
    server: 198.51.100.40
  - name: "Anchor Two"
    <<: *common
    server: 198.51.100.41
    port: 8443

proxy-groups:
  - name: PROXY
    type: select
    proxies: [Anchor One, Anchor Two]

rules:
  - MATCH,PROXY
